test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Children should watch TV from distance as it will affect their eyesight.
solution:
The correct answer is '**TV from distance**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**TV from distance**" is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**TV from a distance**" as the article "a" is needed before "distance".
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **3** are grammatically correct in this context.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"Children should watch **TV from a distance** as it will affect their eyesight."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "as it will affect"** is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 2: "their eyesight"** is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 3: "Children should watch"** is correct and does not contain any errors.
